supersedes: nothing — it re-scores the canonical Diamond Princess record replay (the CREW-REACH-01 boxed_s1s2 configuration verbatim) at one pinned revision under two airflow solvers. The parent surfaces stay measured at their own SHAs; this design is the transport-engine sensitivity of that replay, not a repin of it.
description: Native vs ContamX transport on the declared Diamond Princess replay. Cell shape verbatim from covid_crew_reach_01 (itself verbatim from the MEAL-SVC-02 landed configuration): scenario diamond_princess_2020 on its declared mega_cruise_5000 substitution hull, voyage_mode declared (full 35-day voyage), Θ 7.9e6, infection_age_days 6.8, imports 1, dwell_weighted, 20 seeds at base 20200205. The design-level base_overrides carries the whole boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration — SOP-017-MESSBOX + section-bound steward service with contact_factor_to_host [0.005,0.02] + the record's observation structure (retest_negative_sweeps + the 23-Feb crew_wave) — applied by the campaign worker after prepare_cell_run_spec. The only arm axis is the airflow solver: `native` (empty overrides, the shipped ContamTransportEngine) vs `contamx` (transport_engine: contamx — the committed contam/platform.prj solved by the real NIST ContamX binary). `auto` is not an arm: a contamx cell that cannot build the solver fails closed, and the payload's delivery.transport_engine_resolved echo is the audit of which solver actually ran. No constant, protocol, observation channel, seed or hull is changed between arms.
base_overrides_note: The boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration of CREW-REACH-01 — the boxed crew-mess SOP (SOP-017-MESSBOX) plus section-bound steward service (direction both, service_responder_mode section, cabins [10,15], contact_factor_to_host [0.005,0.02]) plus the record's full observation structure (serial retest tiers and the day-34 crew wave) — applied once to every cell, identical across arms. Composition is order-independent against the single arm axis, which writes only config_overrides.hvac.transport_engine.

arms.note: First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. The shipped native ContamTransportEngine — the solver every prior COVID campaign row ran under. Resolved engine is auditable via delivery.transport_engine_resolved == ContamTransportEngine.

The real NIST ContamX 3.4.0.3 solver on the hull's committed contam/platform.prj (mega_cruise_5000: the declared substitution hull's authentic bundle). Same airflow intent as the native engine reads from air_flow_paths.json; the solved steady-state field is what changes hands (CONTAM-DIVERGENCE-01 measured the divergence on tracer dose). The binary reaches the cell by a sha256-pinned S3 fetch (campaign ledger § binary); a cell that cannot build ContamXTransportEngine fails, never falls back.

cells_note: 2 arms x 20 seeds (20200205..20200224) = 40 cells. Same seed series as the boxed_*/parent campaigns so each contamx cell pairs seed-for-seed with the same-revision native cell and, report-only, with the parent's older-revision payload.
